abstract: The ter (teratoma) gene causes germ cell deficiency and a high incidence of congenital testicular teratomas derived from primordial germ cells in 129/Sv-ter strain mice. Ovarian teratomas in LTXBJ mice originate from ovarian parthenotes. In order to study the function of the ter gene in germ cell development and teratocarcinogenesis, we examined the influence of a foreign genetic background on the ter action by introducing the ter gene of 129/Sv-ter strain mice into C57BL/6J, LTXBJ and C3H/HeJ genetic backgrounds by the backcross method and by thus establishing B6-ter, LTXBJ-ter and C3H-ter ter congenic strains, respectively. Histological analysis showed that germ cell deficiency occurred in both sexes of the ter mutants, through the fetal stages to adulthood, but that congenital testicular teratocarcinogenesis did not occur after the fifth backcross generation. The ter/ter gonads were smaller than normal (+/+ or +/ter). Experimental testicular teratomas never developed from intratesticular grafts of B6-ter genital ridges. LTXBJ-ter/ter females had no ovarian teratomas. It is concluded that the ter gene is solely responsible for germ cell deficiency, but not testicular teratocarcinogenesis, in ter congenic strains having background genes other than 129/Sv-ter and that the ter gene is not involved in ovarian teratocarcinogenesis.
abstract_ja: ter(teratoma)遺伝子は、129/Sv-ter系マウスで胚細胞欠損と、始原胚細胞由来の先天性精巣奇形腫を高頻度に引き起こす。本研究では、ter遺伝子の作用に対する異なる遺伝的背景の影響を検討するため、129/Sv-ter系のter遺伝子を戻し交配によりC57BL/6J、LTXBJ、C3H/HeJの各遺伝的背景に導入し、B6-ter、LTXBJ-ter、C3H-terのter コンジェニック系統を作製した。組織学的解析の結果、胚細胞欠損は胎児期から成体まで両性のter変異体に生じたが、先天性精巣奇形腫発生は第5世代以降の戻し交配では認められなかった。ter/terの生殖腺は正常(+/+または+/ter)より小さかった。B6-terの生殖腺原基の精巣内移植では、実験的精巣奇形腫は形成されなかった。LTXBJ-ter/terの雌には卵巣奇形腫は認められなかった。結論として、ter遺伝子は、129/Sv-ter以外の遺伝的背景をもつter コンジェニック系統において、胚細胞欠損の唯一の原因であり、精巣奇形腫発生の原因ではなく、ter遺伝子は卵巣奇形腫発生に関与しないと考えられる。
